name: Natural History Museum Data Portal API
summary: Keyless CKAN API for the Natural History Museum Data Portal: millions of specimen records and research datasets.
description: The NHM Data Portal is a CKAN instance. package_search and package_show list datasets and their metadata, and datastore_search queries the tabular resources, including the museum's collection specimens (millions of records with taxonomy, locality, coordinates and catalogue numbers).

endpoints.summary: Query records of a tabular resource

license.name: Varies per dataset (the collection specimens dataset reports CC0-1.0)

agent_notes: Standard CKAN action API. Find the resource id with package_show (collection specimens: id collection-specimens, resource 05ff2255-c38a-40c9-b657-4ccb55ab2feb), then page datastore_search with limit and offset. Check license_id per dataset before reuse.
caveats: The portal website (including /about/) returned a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge (403) to curl on 2026-11-11, so no docs page of NHM itself could be read; the API endpoints answered normally.
Licences vary per dataset; check license_id in package_show.
The action_list call returned 400; stick to the documented CKAN actions used here.

verification.notes: Example executed 2026-11-11 (200, access-control-allow-origin: *). package_show and datastore_search (6,312,876 specimen records) also 200.
